notes: Single source of truth for prices. The frontend displays from this file; the Worker (sticker-api/) re-prices every order from this file and never trusts a client price. cost_model is for margin math only and must never be sent to the browser as a price.
pricing_rule: unit_cents = round_half_up(unit_price_cents[size][qty] * (100 + finish.surcharge_pct) / 100); line_cents = unit_cents * qty; subtotal = sum(line_cents); shipping per shipping.methods; total = subtotal + shipping.

cost_model.basis: Sticker Mule die-cut, shipping included. 3 in x 10 = $20 and 3 in x 50 = $72 are the 'normal price' figures on stickermule.com deal pages (seen via search summary 2026-10-29). Everything else is 推断 and must be checked in the Sticker Mule cart before launch.
cost_model.ai_cost_assumption: FLUX.1 Kontext pro $0.04 per image x 3 tries per design / 15% of designers who buy = $0.80 per paid order (推断)
